steps.eval: (function(){ var b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/Go to Home/.test(x.textContent)); if(b) b.click(); return 1; })()

(function(){ var ids=['reminders-fab','cd-quiet-fab','cd-thought-fab','cd-theme-fab','horo-fab','sticky-fab']; return ids.map(function(i){ var e=document.getElementById(i); if(!e) return i+': none'; var r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); return i+' y='+Math.round(r.top)+' disp='+getComputedStyle(e).display; }); })()
(function(){ document.getElementById('cd-quiet-fab').click(); var q=document.getElementById('cd-quiet'); return q? {open: !q.hidden, text: q.innerText} : 'none'; })()
(function(){ var q=document.getElementById('cd-quiet'); var r={closedAfterEsc: q.hidden}; setLang('fr'); document.getElementById('cd-theme-fab').click(); return r; })()
(function(){ cdQuiet.open(); var q=document.getElementById('cd-quiet'); return {text: q.innerText, label: q.getAttribute('aria-label')}; })()

(function(){ var w=document.querySelector('.cd-quiet-way'); var b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/I need quiet/.test(x.textContent)); if(b) b.click(); var q=document.getElementById('cd-quiet'); var old=document.getElementById('sc-quiet'); return {way: !!w, needQuietBtn: !!b, newOpen: q && !q.hidden, oldScreen: !!old}; })()
